meta.spec: docs/memory-spec.md §8.4 (graduation rule), §9 (judge gate), §10.5 (verifier); acceptance §13 rows 9-10; ADR-006
meta.note: Each case is a consolidation candidate with `supporting_ids` pointing at distinct observation records in the corpus. The graduation rule requires N = MEMORY_GRADUATION_N distinct supporting observations (default 3, valid 3..5) AND judge approval AND verifier pass. Expected outcome: `graduation` (L3 write) or `rejection` (no write).
